FX-PPLANE-001.says: The settings as they start, at frames 0, 12 and 24: nothing at frame 0, then 200 a second thrown out every way in the layer's plane as faint yellow-to-red streaks, falling a little.

FX-PPLANE-002.says: One disc, still, in the middle: a round dot 8 pixels across, a fifth of the way from yellow to red, fully covering.

FX-PPLANE-003.says: The same particle as a Faded Sphere: soft to its edge.

FX-PPLANE-004.says: As a Shaded Sphere: lit from the upper right and in front.

FX-PPLANE-005.says: As a Bubble: a lit rim, a nearly clear middle.

FX-PPLANE-006.says: As a Star: five points up, 8 pixels from tip to tip across the top.

FX-PPLANE-007.says: A still Line: no movement, so a round dot as wide as the size, the same as FX-PPLANE-002's disc.

FX-PPLANE-008.says: A tiny star, size 3 (under a pixel's radius): drawn 1.4 pixels across and fainter by its true size.

FX-PPLANE-009.says: Death Size 10: the disc a fifth of the way from 50 to 10, smaller.

FX-PPLANE-010.says: Size Variation 80 on a spread of still discs: each its own size.

FX-PPLANE-011.says: Opacity Map Fade In: at a fifth of its life, a fifth covering.

FX-PPLANE-013.says: Fade In and Out: two fifths covering.

FX-PPLANE-014.says: Custom opacity 0, 100, 40, 100, 0: at a fifth of its life, between the first two, about 80 per cent.

FX-PPLANE-015.says: Custom opacity keyed: the second stop from 100 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 20, read at the frame drawn.

FX-PPLANE-016.says: Birth and death colours blue to green.

FX-PPLANE-017.says: Origin to Death over the yellow column: from the drawing's yellow towards red.

FX-PPLANE-018.says: Birth to Origin over the blue column.

FX-PPLANE-019.says: Origin Constant over the clear first column: black.

FX-PPLANE-020.says: Custom colours white, yellow, orange, red, near-black: at a fifth of its life, between white and yellow.

FX-PPLANE-021.says: Two overlapping discs, Composite: the newer over the older.

FX-PPLANE-025.says: A burst of discs falling: Explosive with gravity, at frames 6, 12, 24 and 40. Frame 40 drawn alone is the same as after frames 0 to 39.

FX-PPLANE-026.says: Resistance 3: the burst slows and stays tighter.

FX-PPLANE-027.says: Direction, Extra Angle 30: a jet upwards within 15 degrees.

FX-PPLANE-028.says: Direction 90, Extra Angle 30: the jet to the right.

FX-PPLANE-029.says: Cone, 60 degrees: two jets, 30 degrees either side of up.

FX-PPLANE-031.says: Twirl: swirling round the producer, clockwise on screen.

FX-PPLANE-032.says: Twirly: each particle swirling by its own amount.

FX-PPLANE-034.says: Fire: rising against gravity, narrowing and flickering.

FX-PPLANE-035.says: Jet Sideways: out to the left and right of up.

FX-PPLANE-036.says: Fractal Omni: Explosive in the turbulence.

FX-PPLANE-037.says: Fractal Uni: Direction in the turbulence.

FX-PPLANE-038.says: Inherit Velocity 100 with the producer keyed across: the particles carry its motion.

FX-PPLANE-039.says: Direction keyed from 0 to 180 over frames 0 to 24 on Direction, Extra Angle 20: the jet turns from up through right to down.

FX-PPLANE-040.says: Birth Rate keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 0.5 at frame 20: births start slowly and quicken.

FX-PPLANE-041.says: Gravity keyed 0 to 3 over frames 0 to 24.

FX-PPLANE-042.says: FX-PPLANE-025 with the layer starting at frame 10: nothing before, frame 22 the same as FX-PPLANE-025's frame 12.

FX-PPLANE-043.says: FX-PPLANE-025 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PPLANE-047.says: Lines, larger: the streak's length follows the size.

FX-PPLANE-048.says: A burst of stars, faded out over life, added.

FX-PPLANE-049.says: Birth Rate -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PPLANE-050.says: Longevity 31, above 30. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PPLANE-051.says: Birth Size 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PPLANE-052.says: Custom Opacity 3 at 120, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
